messages:
Noah Rivera: Hey team — want to ship a short customer microcase for next Thu launch. Need a 15s social clip, a 60s highlight, 1-pager, and webinar mention. Quick checklist?
Maya Singh: I can own copy and the one-pager. Need final KPIs and an approved pull quote from the customer.
Ethan Brooks: I'll pull the infra numbers (P99, avg token cost delta). Should have them by EOD today.
Noah Rivera: Recording plan: remote-record, separate audio track, ask customer for a 10s candid intro + 8-12s b-roll for cuts.
Zoe Kim: Legal flag: customer requires explicit written permission and trademark usage approval. Please surface consent text in the doc.
LegalBot: Use this template: "I consent to Redwood Inference using my quote, company name, and logo in marketing materials related to this launch. I confirm these materials are not marked or designated as confidential." We also need signer name, title, and date.
Maya Singh: Draft social pull: "Redwood made our inference reliable and cut costs — huge for our product roadmap." Prefer punchy. Do we want a stat in social?
Ethan Brooks: Customer prefers qualitative social line. Put exact percentage (~35% token cost reduction) in the case study body only.
Mira Lopez: For lead routing, can we add a hidden form field 'deployment_interest' with options hosted/dedicated/private and map to queues?
OpsBot: Routing rule created: demo leads -> SFDC queue ENT-202, press -> comms, case interest -> customer-success. Webhook URL ready for testing.
Noah Rivera: Great. Ethan — can you add UTM params (utm_campaign=customer_microcase&utm_source=social) to the publish links?
Ethan Brooks: Yep. I'll add the UTM and test the webhook to ENT-202 once the page is live.
Zoe Kim: Also add a consent checkbox on the form: "I authorize Redwood to use my quote and logo as described" with link to the consent PDF.
Maya Singh: I'll draft the interview guide (4 Qs + metrics prompts) and drop it in /files/marketing/guides.
LegalBot: After customer signs, please send signed PDF to legal@redwood.ai. Record signer name/title/timestamp in the email.
Mira Lopez: Customer tentatively available Wed 4pm for recording. I'll confirm and book a meeting invite with recording links.
Noah Rivera: Proposed timeline: signoff Wed morning, record Wed 4pm, assets in design queue Wed night, publish Thu 2pm PT. If anything slips, flag here.
Maya Singh: Copy first draft will be available by Tue EOD.
Ethan Brooks: Infra numbers: P99 down ~30ms, token cost ~35% lower vs prior setup (internal deck linked). Uploading numbers to the shared folder.
Zoe Kim: Customer confirmed they can sign Wed morning. I'll post the signed consent PDF here when received.
Noah Rivera: Perfect — once you drop the signed PDF, OpsBot will kick off the asset checklist and post to #marketing-live. React with :white_check_mark: when your item is done. Thanks all.
file_note: microcase planning, routing, and consent thread
